Copilot Developer

About Us
SparkLayer is a fast-moving AI productivity startup helping mid-market teams automate knowledge work with no-code copilots. We build integrations, templates and managed copilots that embed into everyday apps so businesses ship automations and intelligent assistants in days, not months.

What you'll do
- Design, build and maintain Microsoft Copilot experiences using Microsoft Copilot Studio for customers and internal templates.
- Create Power Automate flows that connect Copilot prompts to backend processes, triggers and approvals.
- Model and manage business data in Dataverse to support prompt orchestration, state and user personalization.
- Integrate Copilot solutions with Microsoft 365 tooling and external APIs; implement secure authentication and data access patterns.
- Troubleshoot deployment issues, monitor usage, and iterate on prompts and flows to improve reliability and ROI.
- Document implementations, run handovers with customers, and train internal teams on operating copilots and flows.

What we need (mandatory)
- Microsoft Copilot Studio
- Power Automate
- Dataverse

Bonus points (preferred / good-to-have)
- Azure OpenAI
- SharePoint

Location and work mode
Fully remote within India. Experience: 0+ years.
